title: UP BOARD CLASS 1 — Environmental Studies | Our Body Health
description: Subject-wise test on Our Body Health (Environmental Studies) for UP BOARD CLASS 1. 25Q.
subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which part of our body helps us to see the world around us?

options.explanation: Ears are responsible for hearing, not seeing.
The nose is responsible for smelling, not seeing.
Eyes are the sense organs that help us to see.
The tongue is responsible for tasting, not seeing.

questions.explanation: Eyes are the sense organs that help us to see.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What should we do every morning to keep our teeth clean and healthy?

options.explanation: Eating sweets can lead to tooth decay and other dental problems.
Brushing our teeth daily helps remove food particles and germs, keeping them clean and healthy.
Not cleaning teeth can lead to the accumulation of plaque, tartar, and bacteria, causing dental problems.
Drinking cold drinks does not contribute to cleaning teeth.

questions.explanation: Brushing our teeth daily helps remove food particles and germs, keeping them clean and healthy.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these is a healthy food that helps our body grow strong?

options.explanation: Chips are high in calories, fat, and sodium, making them an unhealthy choice.
Candy is high in sugar and calories, making it an unhealthy choice.
Fruits and vegetables are natural and provide essential vitamins and minerals, making them healthy food choices for growth.
Cold drinks are often high in sugar and calories, making them an unhealthy choice.

questions.explanation: Fruits and vegetables are natural and provide essential vitamins and minerals, making them healthy food choices for growth.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: We use our __________ to hear different sounds like music or a bell.

options.explanation: Hands are used for touching and feeling, not hearing.
Feet are used for walking and balance, not hearing.
Ears are the sense organs responsible for hearing different sounds.
Legs are used for walking and running, not hearing.

questions.explanation: Ears are the sense organs responsible for hearing different sounds.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Before eating any food, what is the most important thing you should do to stay healthy?

options.explanation: Playing outside does not directly contribute to staying healthy before eating.

options.text: Wash your hands with soap and water
options.explanation: Washing hands thoroughly with soap and water removes germs and dirt, preventing them from entering our body with food.
Watching television does not contribute to staying healthy before eating.
Touching hair can transfer dirt and germs to hands, making it unhealthy before eating.

questions.explanation: Washing hands thoroughly with soap and water removes germs and dirt, preventing them from entering our body with food.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: If you want to run fast in a race, which body parts will you use the most?

options.explanation: While arms are used for balance and movement, they are not the primary body parts used for running.
Legs are primarily used for walking, running, and kicking, providing the power and movement for these actions.
The head is not directly used for running, although it helps with balance and direction.
Elbows are used for bending and straightening the arm, but are not the primary body parts used for running.

questions.explanation: Legs are primarily used for walking, running, and kicking, providing the power and movement for these actions.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Why is it important to take a bath every day?

options.explanation: Getting wet is a result of bathing, but not the primary reason for doing so.
Bathing is done to remove dirt, not to make ourselves dirty.

options.text: To keep our body clean and free from germs
options.explanation: Bathing daily helps to remove dirt, sweat, and germs from our skin, keeping us clean and healthy.
Bathing is not done to waste water, but to maintain personal hygiene.

questions.explanation: Bathing daily helps to remove dirt, sweat, and germs from our skin, keeping us clean and healthy.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these actions helps to keep our body fit and strong?

options.text: Sitting and watching TV all day
options.explanation: Sitting and watching TV all day can lead to a sedentary lifestyle, making our body weak and unfit.
Eating only junk food can lead to an unhealthy diet, making our body weak and unfit.
Playing outdoor games and exercising regularly helps to strengthen our muscles and keeps our body fit and active.
Sleeping very little can lead to fatigue, making our body weak and unfit.

questions.explanation: Playing outdoor games and exercising regularly helps to strengthen our muscles and keeps our body fit and active.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Rina always makes sure to trim her nails regularly. Why is this a good habit for her health?

options.explanation: While long nails may look beautiful, they can also harbor dirt and germs, making them unhealthy.

options.text: To prevent dirt and germs from collecting under them
options.explanation: Dirt and germs can collect under long nails, which can then transfer to our mouth when we eat, leading to illness. Trimming nails prevents this.
Trimming nails does not make fingers longer, it only keeps the nails clean and short.

options.text: So she can scratch things easily
options.explanation: While long nails can be used for scratching, they can also harbor dirt and germs, making them unhealthy.

questions.explanation: Dirt and germs can collect under long nails, which can then transfer to our mouth when we eat, leading to illness. Trimming nails prevents this.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: While playing, Amit falls and gets a small scrape on his knee. What is the immediate and correct first step his parents should take?

options.text: Put a bandage on it without cleaning
options.explanation: Putting a bandage on a wound without cleaning it can trap dirt and germs, leading to infection.

options.text: Clean the wound gently with water and then apply an antiseptic
options.explanation: The first and most crucial step for any minor wound is to clean it thoroughly with water to remove dirt, and then apply an antiseptic to prevent infection.

options.text: Ignore it and let him continue playing
options.explanation: Ignoring a wound can lead to infection and further complications, making it important to clean and treat it immediately.

options.text: Give him a chocolate to make him forget the pain
options.explanation: Giving a chocolate may provide temporary comfort, but it does not address the wound or prevent infection.

questions.explanation: The first and most crucial step for any minor wound is to clean it thoroughly with water to remove dirt, and then apply an antiseptic to prevent infection.

questions.question: Which part of our body helps us to see the world around us?

options.explanation: Ears help us hear sounds, not see.
Nose helps us smell, not see.
Eyes are the sense organs for vision.
Hands help us touch and hold objects, not see.

questions.explanation: Our eyes are the sense organs that help us to see different things, colours, and people.
questions.hint: This organ is located in the face and helps us observe our surroundings.

questions.question: What should we do every morning to keep our teeth clean and strong?

options.explanation: Sweets can cause tooth decay.
Brushing removes food and germs from teeth.
Not washing the mouth can lead to bad breath and tooth problems.
Drinking milk alone does not clean teeth.

questions.explanation: Brushing our teeth every morning (and night) helps to remove food particles and germs, keeping them clean and strong.
questions.hint: This activity involves using a toothbrush and toothpaste.

questions.question: If you want to hear your mother calling you, which body part will you use?

options.explanation: Tongue helps us taste, not hear.
Eyes help us see, not hear.
Ears are the sense organs for hearing.
Skin helps us feel touch, not hear.

questions.explanation: Our ears are the sense organs used for hearing different sounds, including someone calling our name.
questions.hint: This organ is located on the sides of the head and helps us listen.

questions.question: Which of these is a healthy habit to keep our body clean?

options.explanation: Not bathing can lead to dirt and germ buildup.
Dirty hands can transfer germs to food.
Bathing removes dirt and germs from the body.
Playing in mud can make the body dirty.

questions.explanation: Taking a bath every day helps to wash away dirt and germs, keeping our body clean and fresh.
questions.hint: This activity involves washing the entire body with water and soap.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: When you touch something hot, which sense organ helps you feel the heat?

options.explanation: Eyes help us see, not feel heat.
Ears help us hear, not feel heat.
Nose helps us smell, not feel heat.
Skin helps us feel temperature and touch.

questions.explanation: Our skin is the sense organ that helps us to feel touch, pressure, pain, and temperature like heat or cold.
questions.hint: This organ covers the entire body and helps us sense our surroundings.

questions.question: What should we do with our hands before and after eating food?

options.explanation: Playing games does not clean hands.

options.text: Wash them with soap and water
options.explanation: Washing hands removes germs.
Wiping on clothes does not remove germs.
Dirty hands can spread germs.

questions.explanation: Washing our hands with soap and water before and after eating helps to remove germs and prevents us from getting sick.
questions.hint: This activity involves using soap and water to clean the hands.

questions.question: Which type of food makes us strong and helps us grow?

options.explanation: These are junk foods and do not provide essential nutrients.
These are sugary and unhealthy.
These foods provide essential nutrients for growth.
These are fast foods and not very nutritious.

questions.explanation: Fruits, vegetables, and milk are healthy foods that provide essential nutrients, making us strong and helping us grow.
questions.hint: These foods are natural and provide vitamins and minerals.

questions.question: How many fingers do we have on both of our hands combined?

options.explanation: This is the number of fingers on one hand.
This is not the correct number of fingers.
Five fingers on each hand make ten in total.
This is not the correct number of fingers.

questions.explanation: We have five fingers on one hand. So, on both hands combined, we have 5 + 5 = 10 fingers.
questions.hint: Count the fingers on one hand and then double it.

questions.question: Assertion (A): We should cut our nails regularly. Reason (R): Long nails can carry dirt and germs.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.explanation: Both statements are true, and the reason correctly explains the assertion.

options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.explanation: The reason correctly explains the assertion.

options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.explanation: Both statements are true.

options.text: A is false, but R is true.
options.explanation: Both statements are true.

questions.explanation: It is important to cut our nails regularly (Assertion) because dirt and germs can collect under long nails (Reason), which can make us sick if we touch our mouth. Thus, the reason correctly explains the assertion.
questions.hint: Consider the health benefits of cutting nails regularly.

questions.question: Rina wants to be a healthy child. Which of these habits should she follow every day?

options.explanation: Watching too much TV is not a healthy habit.

options.text: Eat only sweets and ice cream.
options.explanation: Eating only sweets is unhealthy.

options.text: Play outdoors and drink plenty of water.
options.explanation: Playing outdoors and drinking water are healthy habits.
Sleeping late is not a healthy habit.

questions.explanation: To be a healthy child, Rina should play outdoors for exercise and drink plenty of water to stay hydrated. Watching too much TV, eating only sweets, or sleeping late are not healthy habits.
questions.hint: Consider activities that promote physical and mental well-being.

questions.question: What should you do *before* eating food to keep yourself healthy?

options.explanation: Playing games is good for health but does not clean hands before eating.
Watching TV is a leisure activity and does not help in cleaning hands.
Washing hands removes germs and prevents sickness.
Sleeping does not clean hands before eating.

questions.explanation: Washing hands before eating removes germs and prevents sickness, keeping us healthy.
questions.hint: This action helps remove dirt and germs from your hands.

questions.question: Which of these is the best food to make your body strong and healthy?

options.explanation: Chips are high in salt and fat but lack essential nutrients.
Candy contains sugar and lacks vitamins or minerals.
Green vegetables provide vitamins and minerals for a strong body.
Cold drinks are high in sugar and do not contribute to body strength.

questions.explanation: Green vegetables are rich in vitamins and minerals that help our body grow strong and stay healthy.
questions.hint: This food group is known for its high nutritional value.

questions.question: Rohan played outside in the park and got his hands and clothes dirty. What should he do immediately to clean himself?

options.explanation: Eating lunch does not clean the body.
Taking a bath removes dirt and germs from the body.
Reading a storybook does not clean the body.
Sleeping does not clean the body.

questions.explanation: Taking a bath helps remove dirt and germs from our body, which is important after playing outside to maintain hygiene and health.
questions.hint: This action helps remove dirt and germs from the body.

questions.question: Why is it important to brush your teeth every morning and night?

options.explanation: Shiny teeth are a side effect but not the main reason.

options.text: To remove food particles and germs
options.explanation: Removing food particles and germs prevents cavities and bad breath.
Brushing does not affect the size of teeth.
Whitening is not the primary purpose of brushing.

questions.explanation: Brushing teeth regularly helps to remove leftover food and germs that can cause cavities and bad breath, keeping our teeth strong and healthy.
questions.hint: This action helps prevent tooth decay and bad breath.

questions.question: Priya often feels tired and sleepy during her classes. Her teacher observed that Priya usually skips her breakfast. What is the most important advice the teacher should give to Priya to help her feel energetic?

options.text: Drink more water throughout the day
options.explanation: While water is important, it does not provide the energy needed to stay active.
Physical activity is good but does not replace the energy from food.

options.text: Eat a healthy breakfast every day
options.explanation: A healthy breakfast provides the energy needed to stay active and focused.
Reducing screen time may help sleep but does not directly provide energy.

questions.explanation: Breakfast is an important meal that provides energy to our body after a long night. Eating a healthy breakfast gives us the energy needed to focus and stay active throughout the day.
questions.hint: This meal is often called the most important meal of the day.
